title: CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #2 OPERATION BLADE OPEN
lines: 01 CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #11 OPERATION FAKE WAVES OPEN
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 2-10
SEASON DETAILS: During the season, players can combine different "Contracts" to clear stages, complete challenges, improve level evaluation, and collect "Contract Bounty" and "Operation Agreement."
- "Contract Bounty" can be used to redeem rewards in "Secret Sanctuary."
- "Operation Agreement" can be used to unlock more Contingency Contract contents.
CROSS-SEASON " SECRET SANCTUARY" OPEN
- Cross-Season Permanent Trade Center New Arrivals:
0011 Tempest Series - 'Afternoon Teatime' for Aciddrop
EPOQUE Collection - Eggcellent Craftsman for Greyy (Re-edition)
Season #11 Furniture – Fake Waves Pennant
- Season #11 Special Trade Center Supplies: Elite Materials, LMD, Furniture Parts, Battle Records, Chips, etc.
NOTE:
- You do not need Sanity to play Contingency Contract stages.
- You need a certain number of completed Contracts to unlock some other Contracts. Please note that the number of completed Contracts DOES NOT EQUAL to Contingency Level.

- Compared with Season #10, Season #11 still has 8 sites in total, but has replaced 2 sites from the previous Season. There will be a new Rotating Operation Site and a new Permanent Operation Site, and the Permanent Operation Site from last Season will be added into Rotating Operation Sites. During the season, there will be 1 Permanent Operation Site and 7 Rotating Operation Sites (rotating daily) for you to challenge. (The first Rotating Operation Site's rotation time and its corresponding challenges on the first day of the event will be extended by 1 day.)
- Several new Contracts and challenge missions will be added to the Season's Permanent Operation Site on June 30, 2023, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- After Season #11 ends, the unused Contract Bounty will be retained.
- After Season #11 ends, all the Operation Agreements you have collected this season will be automatically converted into Operation Fake Waves Supplies. The ratio is 1:1.
- During Season #11, you will receive Credits if your Support Units have helped others in clearing their Contingency Contract stages.
- During Season #11, players can obtain Season #11 Engraved Medal Set by achieving related goals.
02 TARGETED OPERATOR HEADHUNTING OPEN: JOINT OPERATION
DETAILS: During the event, the Targeted Operator Headhunting, [Joint Operation], opens and ONLY the following Operators will appear in the 6* and 5* Operator List of this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Fartooth / Suzuran / Goldenglow / Eunectes
★★★★★: Kazemaru / Ayerscarpe / Ashlock / Sesa / Sora / Corroserum
03 SUPPLIES & CHIPS EVERYDAY ACCESS
DETAILS: All stages in Supplies stay open during the period above.
